device.description: selected device. Returns statistics for the current device, given by :func:`~torch.cuda.current_device`, if :attr:`device` is ``None`` (default).
constraints: device type must be torch.device or int
if device is not provided, returns statistics for the current device

output.description: number of reserved segments from `cudaMalloc()` (as of June 2025, for size >= 1MB allocations). number of reserved segments from `cudaMalloc()` (as of June 2025, for size < 1MB allocations). defined size (see Memory Management section of the Cuda Semantics documentation). number of over-size reserved segments from `cudaMalloc()`.
